hook: *220 m* travelator bridge to link Nampally Metro and railway station
hook_b: *220 m* travelator bridge to link Nampally Metro and railway station
tldr: SCR is building a ₹21 crore foot over bridge with travelators between Nampally Metro station and Hyderabad Deccan station; 10 of its 20 foundations are done.

beats.what: A nine-metre-wide foot over bridge with travelators along most of its length will connect the two stations.
beats.why: It is part of the ₹327 crore Amrit Station redevelopment, after nearly a decade of planning.
beats.care: Rail passengers, including MMTS riders, can reach the Metro without stepping onto busy roads below.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Foundation work is halfway: 10 of 20 foundations completed, SCR CPRO A. Sridhar said. The upgraded station gets 16 lifts, eight escalators and an AC concourse.

cards.q: What matters most in the new Nampally station?

qs: How will passengers move while the old station building is being replaced?

facts.t: The upgraded station will have *16* lifts, *8* escalators and a 500 KLD sewage plant.
Circulation area of *13,550 sq m* with basement parking; platforms 4-6 will handle long-distance trains.

viz.verdict: Halfway on foundations for the Metro-rail link bridge.
The bridge is about 6% of the redevelopment budget.

learn.t: FOB = foot over bridge, a pedestrian bridge over tracks or roads

watch: When SCR completes the remaining 10 foundations and opens the bridge.
